{"content":[{"type":"text","text":" How to Use the Query Tool - okn.us Skip to content okn.us | Fabric How to Use the Query Tool Graph Registry Querying Graphs Building Graphs Uploading Graphs Initializing search okn.us Graph Registry Graph Registry Contribute to the Registry Uploading Graphs Querying Graphs Querying Graphs How to Use the Query Tool How to Use the Query Tool Table of contents OKN Query Page Query Across Graphs Query Specific Graphs Using Comunica query federation Using named graphs in the Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL endpoint Query Using Examples Saving Queries and Downloading Output SPARQL Endpoints Theme 1 Specific Endpoints Cross-OKN query endpoint Sample Query Library Explore Graph Embeddings Model Context Protocol Server Building Graphs Building Graphs Graph Construction Best Practices About External Identifiers Identifier Choices Identifier Choices Biomedical Environmental Geospatial Institutions Justice Ingesting Identifier Sources Uploading Graphs Uploading Graphs Setup a Repo in the Landing Zone Update Graphs in the OKN Update Example Queries Query Knowledge Graphs in the Open Knowledge Network OKN Query Page OKN Fabric offers a query page that enables anyone to query specific Theme 1 graphs or query across graphs (i.e., a federated query). The okn.us Query Page is located at https://apps.okn.us . Query Across Graphs To query over all available data sources, select Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL from the Sources drop down. Be sure to deselect all other sources. This will submit the query to a server-side endpoint federating all sources. Query Specific Graphs Using Comunica query federation The query page allows selection of a single knowledge graph or multiple knowledge graphs to query. From the Sources drop-down menu (shown below) You can select one or many of the graphs comprising OKN. Then you can construct a query in SPARQL using the SPARQL Query pane and run the query against the data sources you selected in the Sources drop down. Click the Run Query button to execute the query. Note: Currently, selecting multiple sources uses the Comunica package to perform a federated query against Triple Pattern Fragment endpoints for those sources. The practical result of this is that the query execution happens locally, in your browser. This can be quite a bit slower than running a SPARQL query within the database server. An alternative approach is detailed below. Using named graphs in the Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL endpoint Instead of selecting individual graphs in the Sources drop-down, deselect them all and choose Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL . This graph is not truly federated, but instead is a large triplestore containing all the OKN knowledge graphs. By default, a query will include all graphs. To select a specific set of graphs to query over, use FROM clauses to list the desired graphs, e.g.: SELECT * FROM <https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/ubergraph> FROM <https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/wikidata> WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 10 Replace the last part of the graph IRI with the shortname of the desired graph in the OKN Registry . Query Using Examples In the EXAMPLES pane, you can select a pre-formulated SPARQL query from the list. The EXAMPLES pane includes queries from distinct Theme 1 graphs as well as from other graphs that are used in the OKN (e.g., Ubergraph), with each example query clearly labeled. Saving Queries and Downloading Output In the SPARQL Query pane, you can click the Save Query button to save your query. It will appear in the SAVED panel as shown below. In the RESULTS pane, you can click the blue download button to download the output of your query. The button is circled in red below. SPARQL Endpoints Fabric deploys standardized API endpoints for each hosted knowledge graph. Currently, Fabric provides the following kinds of APIs: SPARQL : SPARQL is the standard graph querying language for RDF datasets. TPF : TPF (Triple Pattern Fragments) is a low-cost interface to RDF datasets that supports querying a single triple pattern at a time. The Fabric API endpoints can be used progammatically (see below), or else accessed using the OKN SPARQL query page, built on the Comunica knowledge graph querying framework. Theme 1 Specific Endpoints See the OKN Registry entries to view the graphs currently available within the OKN. The service endpoints for SPARQL and TPF are listed in each graph's entry. The SPARQL endpoints are service endpoints only (no user interface). You can query them via the OKN query page, or using a third party SPARQL tool such as Yasgui . The TPF endpoints are service endpoints but also provide a browser UI . {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'assays-from-invitrodb.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: List assays by source from InvitroDB that are found in both ICE and ToxCast\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - biobricks-ice\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX CHEMINF: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEMINF_>\n' +
    'PREFIX CAS: <http://identifiers.org/cas/>\n' +
    'PREFIX EDAM: <http://edamontology.org/>\n' +
    'PREFIX dce: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>\n' +
    'PREFIX BAO: <http://www.bioassayontology.org/bao#BAO_>\n' +
    'SELECT ?assay \n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?assay a BAO:0000015 ;\n' +
    '         dce:source "InvitroDB" .\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 100\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'names-of-chemical-entities.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: List the names of chemical entities and optionally their CAS RN and DSSTOXSID if available\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - biobricks-ice\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX CHEMINF: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEMINF_>\n' +
    'PREFIX CAS: <http://identifiers.org/cas/>\n' +
    'PREFIX EDAM: <http://edamontology.org/>\n' +
    'SELECT  ?cas ?dsstox ?name\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?s a CHEMINF:000000 ;\n' +
    '    rdfs:label ?name .\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?s EDAM:has_identifier ?dsstox.\n' +
    '    ?dsstox a CHEMINF:000568. # DSSTOX SID\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?s EDAM:has_identifier ?cas .\n' +
    '    ?cas a CHEMINF:000446 . # CAS RN\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 200\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'articles-about-abdominal-cell-types.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: Scientific articles in Wikidata about a cell type that Ubergraph says is part of the abdomen\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - ubergraph\n' +
    '#+   - wikidata\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>\n' +
    'PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>\n' +
    'PREFIX wdtn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct-normalized/>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX cell: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000000>\n' +
    'PREFIX abdomen: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_0000916>\n' +
    'PREFIX part_of: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000050>\n' +
    'SELECT DISTINCT ?cell ?cell_label ?article ?title\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?cell rdfs:subClassOf cell: .\n' +
    '  ?cell part_of: abdomen: .\n' +
    '  ?wikicell wdtn:P7963 ?cell .\n' +
    '  ?article wdt:P921 ?wikicell .\n' +
    '  ?article rdfs:label ?title .\n' +
    '  ?cell rdfs:label ?cell_label .\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 1000\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'nde-diseases-mondo-parents.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: "Find all diseases in NDE and the Mondo disease parent terms."\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - federation\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs:   <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>\n' +
    '\n' +
    'SELECT\n' +
    '  ?disease\n' +
    '  (GROUP_CONCAT(\n' +
    '     DISTINCT REPLACE(STR(?parent),\n' +
    '       "^http://purl\\\\.obolibrary\\\\.org/obo/MONDO_", "MONDO:");\n' +
    '     separator=" | "\n' +
    '   ) AS ?directMondoParents)\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  {\n' +
    '    SELECT DISTINCT ?disease\n' +
    '    WHERE {\n' +
    '      ?dataset a schema:Dataset ;\n' +
    '               schema:healthCondition ?disease .\n' +
    '      ?disease rdfs:isDefinedBy obo:mondo.owl .\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '    LIMIT 200\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?disease rdfs:subClassOf ?parent .\n' +
    '    ?parent rdfs:isDefinedBy obo:mondo.owl .\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'GROUP BY ?disease\n' +
    'LIMIT 1000\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'sawgraph-samples-near-PFAS-facilities.rq',
  query: '# Find PFAS results near suspected PFAS industry using facilities, by State\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>\n' +
    'PREFIX fio: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/fio#>\n' +
    'PREFIX fio-pfas: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/pfas#>\n' +
    'PREFIX naics: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/naics#> \n' +
    'PREFIX epa-frs: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/epa-frs#>\n' +
    'PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>\n' +
    'PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>\n' +
    'PREFIX kwgr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/resource/>\n' +
    'PREFIX spatial: <http://purl.org/spatialai/spatial/spatial-full#>\n' +
    'PREFIX coso:<http://w3id.org/coso/v1/contaminoso#> \n' +
    'PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>\n' +
    '\n' +
    'SELECT DISTINCT ?observation  ?stateName ?townName ?concentration ?unit ?normalizedConc ?substance ?date ?facilityName ?industryName WHERE {\n' +
    '  #find s2 cells with detect samples\n' +
    '   ?sp a coso:SamplePoint;\n' +
    '    kwg-ont:sfWithin ?s2, ?town.\n' +
    '   ?observation coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp;\n' +
    '        coso:ofDSSToxSubstance/skos:altLabel ?substance;\n' +
    '        coso:hasResult ?result;\n' +
    '        coso:observedTime ?date.\n' +
    '   ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?concentration;\n' +
    '           qudt:quantityValue/qudt:hasUnit ?rawUnit.  #only detected values\n' +
    '   ?rawUnit qudt:symbol ?unit;\n' +
    '            qudt:conversionMultiplier ?unitConversion.\n' +
    '  BIND((?unitConversion * ?concentration) as ?normalizedConc ) #normalize different units\n' +
    '  ?s2 rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13.\n' +
    '  ?town rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_3;\n' +
    '        kwg-ont:administrativePartOf+ ?state;\n' +
    '        rdfs:label ?townName.\n' +
    '  ?state rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_1;\n' +
    '         rdfs:label ?stateName. \n' +
    '        \n' +
    '  #find facilities in s2 cells\n' +
    '  ?facility kwg-ont:sfWithin ?s2;\n' +
    '  \t\trdf:type fio:Facility;\n' +
    '    \trdfs:label ?facilityName;\n' +
    '        fio:ofIndustry ?industry.\n' +
    '  ?pfasIndustryList rdfs:subClassOf fio-pfas:IndustryCollectionByPFASContaminationConcern;\n' +
    '    \t\t\t\t  fio:hasMember ?industry. \n' +
    '  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryName. \n' +
    '  \n' +
    '} ORDER BY DESC(?normalizedConc) # highest normalized concentration first\n' +
    'limit 100\n' +
    '\n'
}"}]}

{"content":[{"type":"text","text":" How to Use the Query Tool - okn.us Skip to content okn.us | Fabric How to Use the Query Tool Graph Registry Querying Graphs Building Graphs Uploading Graphs Initializing search okn.us Graph Registry Graph Registry Contribute to the Registry Uploading Graphs Querying Graphs Querying Graphs How to Use the Query Tool How to Use the Query Tool Table of contents OKN Query Page Query Across Graphs Query Specific Graphs Using Comunica query federation Using named graphs in the Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL endpoint Query Using Examples Saving Queries and Downloading Output SPARQL Endpoints Theme 1 Specific Endpoints Cross-OKN query endpoint Sample Query Library Explore Graph Embeddings Model Context Protocol Server Building Graphs Building Graphs Graph Construction Best Practices About External Identifiers Identifier Choices Identifier Choices Biomedical Environmental Geospatial Institutions Justice Ingesting Identifier Sources Uploading Graphs Uploading Graphs Setup a Repo in the Landing Zone Update Graphs in the OKN Update Example Queries Query Knowledge Graphs in the Open Knowledge Network OKN Query Page OKN Fabric offers a query page that enables anyone to query specific Theme 1 graphs or query across graphs (i.e., a federated query). The okn.us Query Page is located at https://apps.okn.us . Query Across Graphs To query over all available data sources, select Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL from the Sources drop down. Be sure to deselect all other sources. This will submit the query to a server-side endpoint federating all sources. Query Specific Graphs Using Comunica query federation The query page allows selection of a single knowledge graph or multiple knowledge graphs to query. From the Sources drop-down menu (shown below) You can select one or many of the graphs comprising OKN. Then you can construct a query in SPARQL using the SPARQL Query pane and run the query against the data sources you selected in the Sources drop down. Click the Run Query button to execute the query. Note: Currently, selecting multiple sources uses the Comunica package to perform a federated query against Triple Pattern Fragment endpoints for those sources. The practical result of this is that the query execution happens locally, in your browser. This can be quite a bit slower than running a SPARQL query within the database server. An alternative approach is detailed below. Using named graphs in the Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL endpoint Instead of selecting individual graphs in the Sources drop-down, deselect them all and choose Proto-OKN Federated SPARQL . This graph is not truly federated, but instead is a large triplestore containing all the OKN knowledge graphs. By default, a query will include all graphs. To select a specific set of graphs to query over, use FROM clauses to list the desired graphs, e.g.: SELECT * FROM <https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/ubergraph> FROM <https://purl.org/okn/frink/kg/wikidata> WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 10 Replace the last part of the graph IRI with the shortname of the desired graph in the OKN Registry . Query Using Examples In the EXAMPLES pane, you can select a pre-formulated SPARQL query from the list. The EXAMPLES pane includes queries from distinct Theme 1 graphs as well as from other graphs that are used in the OKN (e.g., Ubergraph), with each example query clearly labeled. Saving Queries and Downloading Output In the SPARQL Query pane, you can click the Save Query button to save your query. It will appear in the SAVED panel as shown below. In the RESULTS pane, you can click the blue download button to download the output of your query. The button is circled in red below. SPARQL Endpoints Fabric deploys standardized API endpoints for each hosted knowledge graph. Currently, Fabric provides the following kinds of APIs: SPARQL : SPARQL is the standard graph querying language for RDF datasets. TPF : TPF (Triple Pattern Fragments) is a low-cost interface to RDF datasets that supports querying a single triple pattern at a time. The Fabric API endpoints can be used progammatically (see below), or else accessed using the OKN SPARQL query page, built on the Comunica knowledge graph querying framework. Theme 1 Specific Endpoints See the OKN Registry entries to view the graphs currently available within the OKN. The service endpoints for SPARQL and TPF are listed in each graph's entry. The SPARQL endpoints are service endpoints only (no user interface). You can query them via the OKN query page, or using a third party SPARQL tool such as Yasgui . The TPF endpoints are service endpoints but also provide a browser UI . Cross-OKN query endpoint SPARQL: https://apps.okn.us/federation/sparql Powered by RENCI and Onai with NSF Award #2535091 Made with Material for MkDocs "},{"type":"text","text":"[

  name: 'assays-from-invitrodb.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: List assays by source from InvitroDB that are found in both ICE and ToxCast\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - biobricks-ice\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX CHEMINF: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEMINF_>\n' +
    'PREFIX CAS: <http://identifiers.org/cas/>\n' +
    'PREFIX EDAM: <http://edamontology.org/>\n' +
    'PREFIX dce: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>\n' +
    'PREFIX BAO: <http://www.bioassayontology.org/bao#BAO_>\n' +
    'SELECT ?assay \n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?assay a BAO:0000015 ;\n' +

    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 100\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'names-of-chemical-entities.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: List the names of chemical entities and optionally their CAS RN and DSSTOXSID if available\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - biobricks-ice\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX CHEMINF: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEMINF_>\n' +
    'PREFIX CAS: <http://identifiers.org/cas/>\n' +
    'PREFIX EDAM: <http://edamontology.org/>\n' +
    'SELECT  ?cas ?dsstox ?name\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?s a CHEMINF:000000 ;\n' +
    '    rdfs:label ?name .\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?s EDAM:has_identifier ?dsstox.\n' +
    '    ?dsstox a CHEMINF:000568. # DSSTOX SID\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?s EDAM:has_identifier ?cas .\n' +
    '    ?cas a CHEMINF:000446 . # CAS RN\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 200\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'articles-about-abdominal-cell-types.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: Scientific articles in Wikidata about a cell type that Ubergraph says is part of the abdomen\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - ubergraph\n' +
    '#+   - wikidata\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>\n' +
    'PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>\n' +
    'PREFIX wdtn: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct-normalized/>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX cell: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000000>\n' +
    'PREFIX abdomen: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_0000916>\n' +
    'PREFIX part_of: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000050>\n' +
    'SELECT DISTINCT ?cell ?cell_label ?article ?title\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  ?cell rdfs:subClassOf cell: .\n' +
    '  ?cell part_of: abdomen: .\n' +
    '  ?wikicell wdtn:P7963 ?cell .\n' +
    '  ?article wdt:P921 ?wikicell .\n' +
    '  ?article rdfs:label ?title .\n' +
    '  ?cell rdfs:label ?cell_label .\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'LIMIT 1000\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'nde-diseases-mondo-parents.rq',
  query: '#+ summary: "Find all diseases in NDE and the Mondo disease parent terms."\n' +
    '#+ tags:\n' +
    '#+   - federation\n' +
    '\n' +
    'PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs:   <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>\n' +
    '\n' +
    'SELECT\n' +
    '  ?disease\n' +
    '  (GROUP_CONCAT(\n' +
    '     DISTINCT REPLACE(STR(?parent),\n' +
    '       "^http://purl\\\\.obolibrary\\\\.org/obo/MONDO_", "MONDO:");\n' +
    '     separator=" | "\n' +
    '   ) AS ?directMondoParents)\n' +
    'WHERE {\n' +
    '  {\n' +
    '    SELECT DISTINCT ?disease\n' +
    '    WHERE {\n' +
    '      ?dataset a schema:Dataset ;\n' +
    '               schema:healthCondition ?disease .\n' +
    '      ?disease rdfs:isDefinedBy obo:mondo.owl .\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '    LIMIT 200\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '\n' +
    '  OPTIONAL {\n' +
    '    ?disease rdfs:subClassOf ?parent .\n' +
    '    ?parent rdfs:isDefinedBy obo:mondo.owl .\n' +
    '  }\n' +
    '}\n' +
    'GROUP BY ?disease\n' +
    'LIMIT 1000\n'
}"},{"type":"text","text":"{
  name: 'sawgraph-samples-near-PFAS-facilities.rq',
  query: '# Find PFAS results near suspected PFAS industry using facilities, by State\n' +
    'PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>\n' +
    'PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>\n' +
    'PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>\n' +
    'PREFIX fio: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/fio#>\n' +
    'PREFIX fio-pfas: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/pfas#>\n' +
    'PREFIX naics: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/naics#> \n' +
    'PREFIX epa-frs: <http://w3id.org/fio/v1/epa-frs#>\n' +
    'PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>\n' +
    'PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>\n' +
    'PREFIX kwgr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/resource/>\n' +
    'PREFIX spatial: <http://purl.org/spatialai/spatial/spatial-full#>\n' +
    'PREFIX coso:<http://w3id.org/coso/v1/contaminoso#> \n' +
    'PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>\n' +
    '\n' +
    'SELECT DISTINCT ?observation  ?stateName ?townName ?concentration ?unit ?normalizedConc ?substance ?date ?facilityName ?industryName WHERE {\n' +
    '  #find s2 cells with detect samples\n' +
    '   ?sp a coso:SamplePoint;\n' +
    '    kwg-ont:sfWithin ?s2, ?town.\n' +
    '   ?observation coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp;\n' +
    '        coso:ofDSSToxSubstance/skos:altLabel ?substance;\n' +
    '        coso:hasResult ?result;\n' +
    '        coso:observedTime ?date.\n' +
    '   ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?concentration;\n' +
    '           qudt:quantityValue/qudt:hasUnit ?rawUnit.  #only detected values\n' +
    '   ?rawUnit qudt:symbol ?unit;\n' +
    '            qudt:conversionMultiplier ?unitConversion.\n' +
    '  BIND((?unitConversion * ?concentration) as ?normalizedConc ) #normalize different units\n' +
    '  ?s2 rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13.\n' +
    '  ?town rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_3;\n' +
    '        kwg-ont:administrativePartOf+ ?state;\n' +
    '        rdfs:label ?townName.\n' +
    '  ?state rdf:type kwg-ont:AdministrativeRegion_1;\n' +
    '         rdfs:label ?stateName. \n' +
    '        \n' +
    '  #find facilities in s2 cells\n' +
    '  ?facility kwg-ont:sfWithin ?s2;\n' +
    '  \t\trdf:type fio:Facility;\n' +
    '    \trdfs:label ?facilityName;\n' +
    '        fio:ofIndustry ?industry.\n' +
    '  ?pfasIndustryList rdfs:subClassOf fio-pfas:IndustryCollectionByPFASContaminationConcern;\n' +
    '    \t\t\t\t  fio:hasMember ?industry. \n' +
    '  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryName. \n' +
    '  \n' +
    '} ORDER BY DESC(?normalizedConc) # highest normalized concentration first\n' +
    'limit 100\n' +
    '\n'
}"}]}
